system.notes:
Public-facing Ares Arms sales host. Customers browse catalogs, review product specs, and submit legal purchase orders. Security is light — this host's purpose is commerce, not data protection. Illegal weapons are not listed here; those transactions happen elsewhere.

Notable data: Registered customer list (useful for blackmail or tracking), sales records, product catalog. Licensed dealers have restricted access to wholesale pricing.

nodes.name: System Access Node
nodes.description: Storefront gateway. Handles customer browsing, catalog queries, and purchase submissions.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Checkout terminal jackpoints. Three sockets under each till counter.

nodes.name: I/O Port
nodes.description: Stock room inventory terminal. Requires staff passcode. Behind the secure door at the rear of the salesfloor.

nodes.name: Sub-Processing Unit
nodes.description: Routes purchase orders, stock queries, and licensed dealer authentication.

nodes.name: Slave Node
nodes.description: Controls in-store security cameras, electronic display cases, and the door mag-lock to the restricted accessories room.

nodes.name: Data Store
nodes.description: Customer records, purchase histories, licensed dealer roster, and wholesale pricing. Primary decker target.

nodes.name: Central Processing Unit
nodes.description: Manages staff authentication, security sheaf, and Ares corporate reporting link.

ioPorts.name: Checkout Till Sockets
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Under-counter jackpoints at each of the 3 checkout tills. Visible and accessible to anyone leaning on the counter.

ioPorts.name: Stock Room Inventory Terminal
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Staff-only stock room at rear of store. Requires key-card to enter the room. Terminal is bolted to the wall next to the shelving units.

ioPorts.name: Manager's Office Workstation
ioPorts.physicalLocation: Manager's office, second floor. Combination lock on the door (3-digit code, usually written on a sticky note nearby).

triggerSteps.label: TS 1
triggerSteps.description: Alert (Passive) fires. System logs an access anomaly and notifies the overnight security monitoring service. Store is likely closed — no physical staff present.

triggerSteps.label: TS 2
triggerSteps.description: Authenticator deploys at SAN. Re-checks all credentials against Ares retail database. Fraudulent SIN or forged dealer license will be flagged immediately.

triggerSteps.label: TS 3
triggerSteps.description: Looper activates on the SN. Security camera feeds begin looping the previous 30 seconds. Physical movement inside the store is now unmonitored from the host perspective.

triggerSteps.label: TS 4
triggerSteps.description: Tracker deploys. Begins following the intruder's persona, logging node movements and access attempts. Data packaged for transmission to Ares Security Division.

triggerSteps.label: TS 5
triggerSteps.description: DS access locked down. Customer records and dealer pricing require elevated credentials. Ares regional security manager receives automated alert.

triggerSteps.label: TS 6
triggerSteps.description: SN mag-locks trigger on all display cases and the restricted accessories room. Physical security drone dispatched from nearest Ares facility (ETA 8 minutes).

triggerSteps.label: TS 7
triggerSteps.description: CPU initiates full audit log freeze. All actions since intrusion are packaged and transmitted to Ares internal security. Evidence collection protocol active.

triggerSteps.label: TS 8
triggerSteps.description: I/O ports physically disabled. Electronic locks on all jackpoint covers engage. Active decker is trapped in-host until connection times out or they crash the CPU.

triggerSteps.label: TS 9
triggerSteps.description: Convergence. GOD trace completes. Ares Security team and contracted response dispatched. Physical location flagged. Dumpshock applied immediately upon disconnection.
